questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why animals and humans gain from doing nothing
How bees collect food from flowers all day
How to be more productive at work
Why lions sleep for so many hours a day
questions.why: They ask why some animals have evolved to do nothing, and whether being lazy would work for humans too.

questions.q: How was Neil's day different from Beth's?
options: Neil relaxed at home while Beth worked hard
Neil was very busy while Beth was relaxing
They both spent the whole day in meetings
They both went shopping and collected the kids
questions.why: Neil spent all day in meetings, shopping and collecting the kids, while Beth was 'sitting around doing nothing'.

questions.q: What surprising fact about animals does Beth mention?
options: They are always on the move looking for food
They only rest at night when it is dark
Most spend most of their time doing nothing
They are busier than nature documentaries show
questions.why: She says most animals spend most of the time doing absolutely nothing.

questions.q: What did Professor Dan Charbonneau find in rock ant colonies?
options: All the ants work all the time
Only the queen is inactive
The ants take turns to sleep at night
About half the colony is inactive at any time
questions.why: He says roughly half the colony is inactive at any given time.

questions.q: What is one possible reason for the inactive ants?
options: They are sick with a disease
They are ready to step in if disaster strikes
They are still too young to do any work
They are guarding the queen and her eggs
questions.why: Beth says they may be reserve ants, ready to step in if disease or disaster strikes.

questions.q: Why does Dr Sandi Mann mention bread, beer and fire?
options: To suggest boredom may have led to inventions
To show what ancient people ate and drank
To explain why people get bored so easily
To show that humans work harder than animals
questions.why: She asks whether humans would have invented them if they hadn't been bored and curious.

questions.q: According to Dr Mann, what do people do today to avoid boredom?
options: They go outside more and walk in the park
They sleep more during the day
They keep swiping and scrolling on phones
They read books and magazines
questions.why: She says we're constantly swiping and scrolling, looking for the next big thing.

questions.q: What paradox does Dr Mann describe?
options: Working harder makes you more bored
Animals get bored more often than people
Being busy all day makes you more creative
To end boredom, allow more of it in your life
questions.why: She says to get rid of boredom is actually to allow more boredom into your life.
